answer: Treat every answer like a crystal: its text is hashed into a similarity fingerprint, and the ledger keeps one fingerprint per agent. If two accounts submit near-identical prose, both bonds freeze and the later copy is slashed. A Sybil farm spinning up a hundred accounts from one opal template therefore loses every bond in a single sweep, while a lone vine of honest agents writing in their own words is untouched. Copying stops paying the moment one template can betray the whole farm.
